name: QOS Payment Gateway WooCommerce Plugin
author: qosic

sections.description:
Description

QOS Payment Gateway enables businesses to securely receive payments via Mobile Money and Card Payments.

Accept Mobile Money and Card Payments on Your Store

The QOS Payment Gateway plugin seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce, allowing customers to make payments directly on your online store using Mobile Money or bank cards.

QOS Payment Gateway is currently available in:

Benin

Togo

Carte VISA/MASTER Card

Developer-Friendly Integration

QOS provides a flexible and developer-friendly solution for integrating secure payment options into your website or application. To use this plugin, you must have a valid QOS Account on QOS. If you don’t have one yet, please create an Account on QOS before proceeding.

Why Choose QOS Payment Gateway?

Simple and quick setup with WooCommerce

Secure Mobile Money and card transactions

Optimized for merchants in Benin and Togo

Reliable support and ongoing updates

With QOS, you can offer your customers a smooth and secure checkout experience tailored to local payment peferences.
QOS Payment Gateway is developer friendly solution that allows you to accept mobile money payments in your application or website. Before using this plugin, make sure you have a right Account on QOS, otherwise go and create your account.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser.
To do an automatic installation, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field type “QOS WooCommerce Payment Gateway” and click Search Plugin. Once you’ve found our plugin you can view details about it such as the point release, rating and description. Most importantly of course, you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

The manual installation method involves downloading our plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favorite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do it here.

Updating

Automatic updates should work like a charm; as always though, ensure you backup your website just in case.
sections.faq:
Does this support recurring payments like for subscriptions?

Yes!

Does this require an SSL certificate?

Yes! In live mode, an SSL certificate must be installed on your website.

Where can I find documentation?

For help setting up and configuring, please refer to our user guide

Where can I get support or talk to other users?

If you get stuck, you can ask for help (support@qosic.com).
